name: Iron Titan

specialAbility.name: Iron Wall
specialAbility.description: Deploys massive iron armor plates that double its shield power for one turn — good luck getting through that!

lore: Iron Titan is built like a walking fortress on wheels! Every inch of this beast is covered in thick steel armor plating, and it weighs about as much as a real castle. When it activates Iron Wall, giant slabs of extra armor slam down around it like a vault door closing. You can hit it all day long and it just laughs — CLANG CLANG CLANG — nothing gets through!
